reason: First evaluation exposed missing source ETA features before 2019, absent independent rank-free validation, and pooled pitcher first-year role mismatch. Amendments correct these mechanisms; evaluation remains exposed, not untouched.
changes: Published ETA excluded from trained predictor because no pre-2019 source ETA fields are available. Current published ETAs remain separate comparison evidence.
Rank-free variant selected and calibrated only on pre-2019 development labels, then evaluated separately.

Prior-season MiLB starting share added to pitcher workload distance, using archived GS/GP available before the forecast origin. Missing share is explicit; no actual future MLB role used as a predictor.
Regular-role probability calibration is a monotone power transform fitted only on 2014/2015 forecasts and outcomes through 2018, preserving CDF ordering and zero probability before debut.
Selection workload MAE normalized by fixed role reference exposure, preventing PA/IP units from deciding the same tuning parameter.
Current ages calculated at April 1, 2027 from verified birth dates where available; otherwise rounded snapshot age plus half a year, disclosed as approximate.
